name: Benzbromarone

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France and Portugal, first in 2003 — for liver harm

similar.name: Benziodarone
problems: Pulled from the market in France and United Kingdom, first in 1964 — for liver harm

similar.name: Benzarone
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany, first in 1992 — for liver harm

similar.name: Amiodarone
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm, breathing problems and liver harm

summary: Benzbromarone was pulled from the market in France and Portugal starting in 2003 because of liver harm [3]. In tests run on a small computer model rather than on people, the drug received a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. Similar drugs have also caused safety concerns, such as Benziodarone and Benzarone being pulled from markets in Europe for liver harm, and Amiodarone receiving a strong boxed warning in the United States for heart, breathing, and liver harm [4][5].
